On it — I pulled the hot metrics from the private cluster. Quick snapshot:
- Host-level CPU: normal (60–70%) on most pods; one node (node-10) shows sustained memcpy stalls.
- GPU utilization: 85% on average but with increased variance; KV cache miss rate jumped 6x on the affected model shard.
- Queue depth: request queue for model 'aw-recall-v2' hit sustained backlog for 18 minutes before shedding.
- 5xx pattern: majority 502/504, tied to backend decode timeouts (not auth).

Immediate suggested actions (we can push within 20–30 minutes):
1) Switch 'aw-recall-v2' serving policy to the fallthrough model variant (lower mem footprint, slightly higher latency baseline) for 25% of traffic — reduces KV pressure while preserving correctness.
2) Apply kernel-level workaround: increase cuda_mem_pool_limit and apply temporary memcpy pacing (kernel_profile_0728.log attached) — reduces memcpy stalls on node-10.
3) Lower max-batch by 30% for the hottest route and enable response-prefetch short-circuit for tail requests.

I'll stage 1) and 3) first. If those don't bring p99 under control we do a rolling restart of node-10 after evicting pods. I expect visible improvement if KV miss and batching are primary drivers.

Marcus
